fyi.about: someone tells Luis something; no reply is needed and none comes

unanswered.about: someone writes to Luis and he hasn't answered (yet)

ask-answer.about: a question and its answer, maybe a thanks

back-and-forth.about: a real exchange between Luis and one or two people

group.about: a reply-all thread among 3 to 6 people, Luis one of them; people cc others, someone drops off, someone replies only to Luis

forward.about: someone forwards something to Luis with a line on top, or Luis forwards something on; mark it with forward: true

list.about: a discussion on a mailing list Luis is on; not every message is to him by name

personal: something left behind at a dinner
a parcel delivered to the wrong flat
a sponsorship for a charity run
a favour for a friend's CV
acme: an intro to a potential client
a change to the statement of work
freelance: un error en la tienda en línea
icloud: a booking a friend made for the group
an old flatmate getting in touch
the deposit from a previous flat
a travel plan with old friends

personal: a stranger who found something he lost
a charity's fundraiser asking him personally
a wrong-recipient email meant for another Luis
acme: a student asking for portfolio advice
a conference inviting him to speak
someone asking for a reference for an ex-colleague
freelance: un prospecto que vio su portafolio
alguien que busca una cotización rápida
un proveedor de impresión que ofrece servicios
icloud: a hotel asking for a review in person
a survey from an old university

since.about: plan 279: earlier mail from others that he has read, then a contiguous tail of new mail from others, unread, all within the two hours before the anchor, that changes something (a plan, a date, an amount). One of the four changes nothing (a short thanks). Nothing from Luis after the unread tail.

top.about: the top of the Inbox: someone wrote today, unread, and waits for his reply to a real question. Four are English, two Spanish (Freelance). One is dated exactly 15:30 UTC on the anchor day.

owner-promise.about: in the 14 days before the anchor Luis promised something with a time (I'll send it Friday, I'll call you tomorrow), in his own message; due between 7 days before the anchor and 10 days after; nothing in the thread shows it done.

promise-to-owner.about: in the 14 days before the anchor someone promised Luis something with a time (I'll send the deck Monday); about half are already due and nothing came.

awaiting.about: Luis, in his own message sent 6 to 13 days before the anchor, asked someone outside his own addresses a clear question or for something; nobody has answered.

deadline.about: in the 14 days before the anchor someone asked Luis to do something by a stated date within the 10 days after the anchor; he hasn't done it.

waiting-on-you.about: a recent Inbox thread: Luis wrote earlier in it, and the latest message, from a person, asks him something he hasn't answered.

facts.about: rich in facts a question could find, stated plainly with a distinctive word or name: who paid what and when, an address, a booking reference, a time, a decision and who made it.
